cv-cvchelsea.content:
# Tim Everard
Epsom, Surrey · tim.everard@hotmail.co.uk · linkedin.com/in/tim-everard

## Profile
Operations manager with more than ten years running the budgets, kit, systems and people behind live sport and entertainment events. Most recently Head of Esports Operations at BLAST, where I led a six-person department across six game titles. Over six years there I worked with €12m+ in budgets across 60+ flagship events and 300+ qualifiers in 13 countries. I built the department's own tools for bookings, contracts, budgets, equipment tracking and deadlines, and I like making detailed, everyday work run without escalation. Designated Safeguarding Lead at live events. Based in Epsom, close to Cobham.

## What I bring to this role
- **Budgets and cost control:** managed equipment and staffing budgets across six titles, ran monthly budget meetings with my department to keep us aligned on costs, approved invoices, decided when to hire, buy or repair kit, and costed new tournament work with the product and commercial teams.
- **Systems and data:** built my own freelancer booking system using Airtable and HTML pages (with AI support), plus in-house tools covering tournament operations, event and equipment tracking, freelancer calendars, bookings, contracts, budgets and deadlines, and set technical requirements for commercial partners.
- **Procurement and inventory:** handled contracts, purchase orders and invoices for all freelancers, bought studio and event equipment, managed suppliers, and kept track of kit across events, venues and team bootcamps.
- **Team leadership:** led a six-person department, booked and managed 2,000+ freelancers, and trained staff and crew on kit and workflows.
- **Safeguarding:** Designated Safeguarding Lead and first aider at live events.
- **Working across a complex organisation:** main tournament contact for FACEIT, ESIC and BLAST Premier teams, working closely with product and commercial teams.

## Experience
### BLAST · Jan 2020 – Oct 2026
Across six years: 60+ flagship esports events, 300+ qualifiers, 13 countries, 2,000+ freelancers and €12m+ in budgets.

**Head of Esports Operations** · Jun 2023 – Oct 2026
- Led a six-person department running tournament operations across every BLAST title: CS2, Dota 2, Brawl Stars, Fortnite, Rocket League and Rainbow Six
- Ran monthly budget meetings with the department to keep everyone aligned on costs
- Handled contracts, purchase orders and invoices for all freelancers
- Built a freelancer booking system using Airtable and HTML pages, with AI support
- Built the department's own tools for tournament operations, event and equipment tracking, freelancer calendars, contracts, budgets and deadlines
- Rebuilt how the department works, with clear ownership and proper documentation
- Costed and pitched new tournament work with the product and commercial teams
- Set technical requirements for commercial partners
- Brought Team Operations into the department, so player support for online and offline events sat with one team
- Grew the operation from one title when I joined to six, with the department growing by six people

**Tournament Operations Manager** · Jan 2020 – Jun 2023 (contractor until Mar 2021)
- Managed equipment and staffing budgets for CS:GO, Dota 2, Apex Legends, FIFA, Fortnite and Rainbow Six events
- Approved invoices and decided when to hire, buy or repair tournament kit
- Booked and managed freelancers for internal, external and online productions
- Sorted venues and equipment for team bootcamps
- Main tournament contact for FACEIT, ESIC and BLAST Premier teams
- Designated Safeguarding Lead and first aider at live events

### Broadcast and Studio Manager, Jam Television, Birmingham · Mar 2018 – Jan 2019
- Designed a multi-camera studio from scratch, bought the kit, and oversaw the install and testing
- Managed the studio budget, equipment purchasing, suppliers and invoices
- Kept a 24-hour channel on air: hired freelancers, ran the rotas, and covered holidays and emergency call-outs
- Trained new staff on the studio kit and workflows

### Broadcast Freelancer · Jan 2018 – Jan 2020
- Technical director, producer and graphics operator on live broadcasts and events for the BBC, Sky Sports, ITV, BLAST Pro Series and ESL, and consulted on production and technical setups

### Production Manager, ESL UK, Leicester · Jul 2015 – Dec 2017
- Built and set up the technical infrastructure for two studios, and managed production for both and for external events including MCM, EGX and Formula E
- Ran production budgets and bought studio and event equipment
- Hired freelance crew, managed rotas and trained crew on kit and workflows

### Senior Lighting and Event Technician, Dorking Halls (Mole Valley District Council) · Jun 2012 – Jun 2015
- Ran the equipment and training budget, and taught in-house lighting training
- Looked after the kit for a theatre and two cinemas, and carried out PAT testing on the venue's electrical equipment

**Earlier:** Casual Technician at Dorking Halls (2010 – 2011), including equipment upkeep and stock checks. Touring lighting and sound (2011 – 2012), including Enter Shikari, Lee Mack and comedy tours with Jimmy Carr, Dara Ó Briain and Ed Byrne.

## Skills
Budget management and cost control · Purchase orders and invoice approval · Procurement and supplier management · Equipment and inventory control · Building operational tools and processes (Airtable, HTML, AI-assisted) · Defining technical requirements · Team leadership · Freelancer and rota management · Safeguarding (Designated Safeguarding Lead) · First aid
cv-cvchelsea.jd: Chelsea FC, Senior Manager, Admin & Operations (Football Schools). Cobham and Stamford Bridge, permanent full time, closing 6 Nov. Owns data, reporting and MI; budgeting and forecasting; systems and platform selection; customer and commercial administration; procurement, inventory and central resources; insight and forward planning; team leadership (3 direct reports); data protection and safeguarding compliance.
cv-cvchelsea.notes:
## What I changed
- Led with budgets, systems, procurement, inventory and team leadership, the role's core essentials
- Added monthly budget meetings, freelancer contracts, POs and invoices, and the Airtable booking system you built
- Put Designated Safeguarding Lead up front (customer base is mostly children)
- Noted Epsom is close to Cobham (on-site role)
## Gaps to cover honestly
- Monthly reporting to a director and P&L variance (partly covered by the monthly budget meetings)
- Customer billing, collections and subscription admin at volume
- UK GDPR and consent management
- Leading a CRM, registration or ERP platform selection (your Airtable build is the nearest evidence)
- Power BI or Tableau
